en.Архив содержит сведения о системе, настр: The archive contains system, settings and work-log information. The user and computer names, e-mail addresses, network addresses, serial numbers and secret-looking values are removed automatically, but the cleaning may be incomplete: the logs can still hold paths outside your profile (for example on another drive) and names of networks, programs and devices. Open the archive and review it before sending. Nothing is sent — the file is saved to your desktop; if the desktop syncs with OneDrive, the file will be uploaded to the cloud.
Local Lycoris diagnostics archive. Inside: report.txt (system information), settings.json (safe settings), journal.txt (number of changes by kind) and up to three latest work logs. The user and computer names, e-mail addresses, network addresses, serial numbers and secret-looking values were removed automatically, but the cleaning is not guaranteed to be complete: the logs can still hold paths outside the profile (for example on another drive) and names of networks, programs and devices. Open the files and review them before sending. The archive is not sent automatically.
en.Отчёт не сохранён: рабочий стол не найде: Report not saved: the desktop is not inside your profile folder, is on a network drive or is redirected by a link. Nothing was written.
en.Отчёт не сохранён: не удалось определить: Report not saved: the desktop user could not be determined. Start Lycoris without administrator rights and try again.
en.Создать обезличенный архив диагностики н: Create an anonymized diagnostics archive on the desktop.
en.Оценка ПК и все проверки «Панели» с пояс: PC score and every «Dashboard» check with an explanation
en.Сводка о системе: Windows, процессор, ви: System summary: Windows, processor, graphics card, memory, drives, monitors
en.Последний замер «до / после», если он ес: The latest «before / after» measurement, if there is one
en.Без имени пользователя и компьютера, без: No user or computer name, no serial numbers and no network addresses
en.Отчёт создан на этом ПК и никуда не отпр: The report was created on this PC and was not sent anywhere.
